items.difficulty_reason: 86 行完整证明：拓扑层（profinite 闭映射 + clopen 精细）与代数层（开浸入像为有限盒并 + 不可约交集非空）两段论证均在 span 内做完。中段『平移后不妨设 Z = G^0 (details omitted)』所省内容已由前句 Z = G^0 z 在 span 内给出（平移自同构），属降阶机制、非承重数学内容，卡内 editorial note 记明。9 处引用全部带 canonical tag。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-compact-set-in-affine (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1307-1314

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: T is profinite as a topological space; a quasi-compact open W containing f(T) is made G^0-invariant; the closed map T -> pi_0(W) and the profinite clopen refinement produce finitely many affine opens U_xi whose preimages cover T, giving an affine U_0 containing f(T) per component; each component Z meeting f(T) has a rational point and is a translate of G^0, so after translation the problem reduces to G = G^0 irreducible with an affine neighbourhood U of e; the open immersion U x_k T -> G x_k T has an image that is a finite union of boxes because |U x_k T| = |U| x |T|, hence only finitely many translates U f(t)^{-1} occur, and since G is irreducible their intersection is nonempty and contains a k-rational point g, giving f(T) subset g^{-1}U (source lines 1316-1401)
